0022600209.text: The Suns (2-5, 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back) host the Spurs (7-2, 4th in the West and 2nd in the Southwest), who enter on a seven-game winning streak, with Phoenix 2-2 at home and San Antonio 3-0 on the road. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was a 101-100 Suns loss in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
